spans.s: tejaḥ-svāmya (IE 8-5; EI 16), cf. aṣṭabhoga-tejaḥsvāmya; tejaḥsvāmya is tejo-yukta-svāmya, ‘ownership endowed with full authority’, which resulted from the eight (i. e. all or various) kinds of enjoyment. See tejo-mānya.
tejo-mānya, cf. teja-mānyam (SITI), the ownership of landed property with the aṣṭa-bhoga or eight (various or all) kinds of enjoyment; also called tejaḥ-svāmyam.
